source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Washer (Job Aid L-78)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body:
Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

If the door is stuck locked and you need access before continuing, the manual unlock steps are in Service & test mode reference below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Disconnect DL3 at CCU
steps.body: Access the door lock at the CCU: remove top cover and console, remove lower front access panel, open the door, and release the bellows retaining wire to reach the lock harness. Disconnect door lock/unlock solenoids connector DL3 from the CCU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: §4-14 — remove console and access panel; release bellows wire; disconnect DL3 at CCU.

steps.title: Door lock solenoid DL3 pins 1 & 3
steps.body: Set ohmmeter to R×1. Measure DL3 pins 1 and 3 (lock solenoid). Expected 60 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Set ohmmeter to R×1. Measure DL3 pins 1 and 3 (lock solenoid). Expected 60 Ω.

images.caption: Door lock DL3 & door switch DS2 (§5-5)

steps.title: Door unlock solenoid DL3 pins 2 & 3
steps.body: Measure DL3 pins 2 and 3 (unlock solenoid). Expected 60 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure DL3 pins 2 and 3 (unlock solenoid). Expected 60 Ω.

images.caption: Door lock DL3 & door switch DS2 (§5-5)

steps.title: Disconnect DS2 at CCU
steps.body: Disconnect door switch connector DS2 from the CCU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect door switch connector DS2 from the CCU.

steps.title: Door switch DS2 — closed = 0 Ω
steps.body: With ohmmeter on DS2 pins 3 and 1: does the door switch read 0 Ω (continuity) when the door is fully closed, and open (OL) when the door is open?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Door Closed = 0 Ω; Door Open = infinite — DS2 pins 3 and 1.

steps.title: Replace door lock
steps.oemOutcome: Replace door lock assembly when lock or unlock solenoid open or out of range.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace door lock/switch assembly for DS2 fault (F26).

steps.title: Isolate harness for continuity test
steps.body: DL3 or DS2 failed at the CCU — the fault may be the lock assembly or an open/shorted harness wire. DL3 and DS2 should still be unplugged at the CCU. At the door lock assembly, disconnect DL3 and DS2 so the harness is open on both ends. Power must remain off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: When component ohms fail at the CCU, disconnect wiring at both ends before pin-for-pin harness continuity.

images.caption: Door lock DL3 & door switch DS2 (§5-5)

steps.title: Pin-for-pin harness continuity (DL3 & DS2)
steps.body:
Set the ohmmeter to ohms (R×1). With the harness disconnected at both the CCU and the lock assembly, check each wire by itself — one meter lead on a pin at the CCU connector and the other lead on the same pin number at the lock connector.

DL3 (3 wires on this platform): pin 1 ↔ pin 1, pin 2 ↔ pin 2, pin 3 ↔ pin 3. Each pair should read continuity (≈0 Ω). OL on any wire = open harness.

DS2 door switch: pin 3 ↔ pin 3 and pin 1 ↔ pin 1 — same continuity expectation.

Also verify no continuity between different pins on the same connector (short). Repair or replace the harness if any wire is open or shorted.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check the harness of the suspected component between the CCU and door lock mechanism for continuity.

branches.label: All wires show continuity, no shorts
Open wire or short between pins
branches.oemOutcome: Replace door lock harness — open or shorted wire between CCU (DL3/DS2) and lock assembly.

steps.title: Reconnect DL3 and DS2
steps.body: Reconnect DL3 and DS2 at the door lock assembly, then at the CCU. Seat connectors fully and confirm no damaged terminals before restoring power.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect door lock/unlock solenoids connector DL3 and door switch DS2 at the CCU.

steps.title: Continue to Manual Diagnostic Test
steps.body: Restore power. Follow the Manual Diagnostic Test steps on the next screens to enter service mode and exercise the door lock from the CCU. The first step locks the door — listen for the solenoid click.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual Diagnostic Test §6-7 — door lock is the first exercised output.

steps.title: Door lock energizes in Manual Diagnostic Test
steps.body: During Manual Diagnostic Test, advance to the door lock step. Does the lock solenoid energize (audible click / latch movement) when commanded?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual Overview Test Program §6-7 — door lock step.

branches.label: Lock does not energize
branches.oemOutcome: Lock and harness verified at component — no energize from CCU in manual test. Suspect CCU output or control.

steps.title: Replace door lock harness
steps.oemOutcome: Replace harness between CCU (DL3/DS2) and door lock assembly.

steps.title: Door lock path verified
steps.oemOutcome: Component, harness, and CCU lock output verified. Continue mechanical checks for intermittent complaints.

steps.title: Suspect CCU / control
steps.oemOutcome: Replace CCU when lock circuit and harness test good but lock does not energize in manual diagnostic test.
